subject: GovSpace — request for GovCloud sandbox credits & short trial extension
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GovSpace — request for GovCloud sandbox credits & short trial extension

Team,

Quick ask from GovSpace (partner prospect focused on GovCloud customers). They ran a successful invite-only roundtable yesterday and would like us to provide a small batch of sandbox/trial credits they can distribute to their guestlist plus a 30‑day extension for two evaluation VPC instances so their security team can complete the FedRAMP-style questionnaire.

Numbers: 50 total trial units: 25 "attendee" codes (self-serve webinar redemption) + 25 "engineer" concierge codes (we seed and monitor usage). They specifically need the extension to cover private/VPC environments (not the hosted API).

Attached: GovSpace_MOU_draft.pdf (draft MOU they sent).

Would like a fast check: can we approve 50 credits + 30 day private-sandbox extension under deal GS-2027-049? If yes I'll loop in GovSpace and send the promo codes + DocuSign link. Also calling out cost/concessions: this will be treated as partner co-marketing, sponsorship credit — we should use the standard partner-cost bucket if approved.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Partner Programs — Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GovSpace — request for GovCloud sandbox credits & short trial extension

Naomi —

Thanks for flagging. I'm OK with 50 total promo units and a one‑time 30‑day private/VPC sandbox extension as partner co-marketing. Two conditions before we hand out codes:
- Legal signs the attached MOU (please route to legal via DocuSign).
- Finance confirms we can expense under the partner marketing budget line GS-PA2027 (I'll ping Finance now).

If those check out, please proceed with promo generation and provide separate code pools for attendee vs engineer flows so we can track redemption. Also include a short success metric (e.g., 30% activation within 14 days) so we can evaluate promotional effectiveness.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Growth — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Jul 2027 12:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GovSpace — request for GovCloud sandbox credits & short trial extension

Looping in ops details — happy to generate the codes and stand up the two sandbox instances for the 30‑day window. Implementation notes:
- I'll create two code groups: GOV-ATTENDEE-#### (25 unique single-use codes) and GOV-ENG-#### (25 single-use codes tied to handouts we can redeem on request).
- Promo codes will map to private sandbox projects that spin up pre-configured GovCloud/VPC images with audit logging enabled.
- I'll export the codes to promo_codes_list.csv and share for Marissa/Naomi review.
- Ops cost: rough estimate is a $1,200 delta for the 30‑day reserved infra plus monitoring — tagging to deal_id GS-2027-049 and partner bucket. See ops_cost_summary.xlsx attached.

Next steps for me once legal & finance confirm: generate codes, upload to Partner Promo UI, and provide redemption tracking link. ETA: 24 hours after approvals.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

---

From: Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@govspace.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@govspace.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jul 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GovSpace — request for GovCloud sandbox credits & short trial extension

Naomi + team,

Really appreciate the quick turnaround and the team's flexibility. GovSpace confirms we accept the 50 promo units + 30‑day private sandbox extension under GS-2027-049 pending MOU signature. Two quick asks from our side:
1) Can the attendee codes expire after 60 days from issue? We want a short redemption window for the marketing push.
2) DocuSign: please send the link for the MOU and we will have our legal team sign it this week.

We're excited to get the engineers into the sandbox images — Tom will be the primary technical contact (cc'd). Once codes are posted, we'll share them in the post-event follow-up email to attendees and coordinate a short onboarding office hour (possible date: Aug 6).

Best,
Sara Bennett
Head of Partnerships — GovSpace Inc.
sara.bennett@govspace.io
